steps.html:

steps.title: Everything you have met so far
steps.html:
WhenPositiveNegativeQuestion
every dayShe works here.She doesn't work here.Does she work here?
yesterdayShe worked here.She didn't work here.Did she work here?
to be, nowShe is a nurse.She isn't a nurse.Is she a nurse?
to be, pastShe was a nurse.She wasn't a nurse.Was she a nurse?

do / does and did carry the tense. The main verb after them never changes.

to be never uses do or did. It makes its own negatives and questions.
